g.title: ICP_QSP
g.text: Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) — QSP mechanistic map
Two causal chains: the bile acid axis (fetal death) and the autotaxin axis (itch) diverge from the same lesion and respond to different drugs
